meta_title: Church View Nursery | Garden Centre Leicester
meta_description: Church View Nursery is a family-run garden centre in Barkby, Leicester. Expert plants, landscaping advice, and outdoor living solutions. Visit us today.
hero_eyebrow: Family-Run Garden Centre — Expert Plant & Landscaping Advice
hero_subhead: Discover quality plants, expert gardening advice, and everything you need to transform your outdoor space in Barkby.
services_heading: Complete Garden & Landscaping Services in Leicestershire
services_subhead: From plants and garden furniture to full landscaping design and installation, we've got everything to bring your garden to life.

services.title: Landscape Design & Installation
services.desc: Bespoke garden designs tailored to your space and budget. Our team handles the entire process — from initial consultation through to planting and hardscaping.

services.title: Plant Selection & Advice
services.desc: Expert guidance on choosing the right plants for your soil, sunlight, and climate. We stock thousands of seasonal and perennial varieties.

services.title: Garden Furniture & Outdoor Living
services.desc: Premium garden furniture, decking materials, and outdoor accessories. We help you create a space perfect for entertaining and relaxation.

services.title: Mulch, Compost & Top Soil
services.desc: High-quality growing media and soil improvers delivered and installed. Essential for healthy plant growth and garden maintenance.

services.title: Garden Maintenance Supplies
services.desc: Everything from tools and seeds to pesticides and fertilisers. Our knowledgeable staff can recommend the right products for your needs.

services.title: Seasonal Planting & Bedding
services.desc: Pre-grown seasonal displays and bedding plants ready to brighten your garden. Perfect for containers, borders, and instant colour.

about_pullquote: We believe every garden tells a story. Ours is built on passion and deep roots in Leicestershire.
about_para_1: Church View Nursery has been a cornerstone of the Leicestershire gardening community for over two decades. What started as a small family operation on Queniborough Road has grown into a trusted destination for local gardeners, landscapers, and plant lovers. We've cultivated lasting relationships with our customers by combining expert horticultural knowledge with genuine care for every project we're involved in.
about_para_2: Our reputation rests on a simple promise: we stock only quality plants and materials, and we back our advice with real experience. Whether you're a first-time gardener or a seasoned landscaper, you'll find that we take the time to understand what you're trying to achieve. Many of our customers return season after season because they know they'll get honest recommendations, competitive pricing, and plants that thrive.
reviews_heading: What Leicester Gardeners Say About Us

reviews.text: Brilliant selection of plants and the staff really know their stuff. I came in looking for something specific and they not only had it but spent 20 minutes telling me how to care for it. Will definitely be back for my summer bedding.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Had Church View design and landscape our back garden last summer. The whole team was professional, tidy, and finished on time. The garden looks stunning and everything has taken beautifully. Highly recommended.
reviews.author: Christine H.

reviews.text: Best local garden centre around. Prices are fair, the plants are healthy, and you actually feel like they want to help you succeed rather than just make a sale. Can't fault them.
reviews.author: David R.
